info.name: TaskMaster API
info.description: Every request of the TaskMaster API, in an order that works top to bottom with the Collection Runner. Two users are registered (Asha and Ravi) with fresh emails on every run, and ids are captured into collection variables as they are created. Set baseUrl if the API is not on http://localhost:8080.
